headline: Nicușor Dan raises alarm after Standard & Poor's decision: “This is not a moment to relax”. What Romania risks - ProTV News
summary: Nicusor Dan raised concern after Standard & Poor's issued a decision on Romania, saying it was not a moment to relax. Media reported on what the country risks.
why: S&P is one of the major credit rating agencies, and its sovereign rating decisions affect Romania's government borrowing costs and the pricing of its bonds.
